This looks simple and uninteresting, but me and my spouse found ourselves playing this compulsively for few weeks already, on every platform available. Excellent, but be warned: it is highly addictive! Aw man, I loved this game!!! The fave color at the first play set up was awesome. I picked blue! The gameplay was awesome! The best part was the use of the Steam Workshop and how you could share puzzles you make in the editor to the workshop! This game is the best! Well, it's Picross with hundreds of puzzles (5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x20) plus a thousand of player-created puzzles on the workshop. 


Even if there are logic issues in some puzzles (multiple solution in a Picross game? Seriously?) this is the only Steam alternative to play Picross.
